metadata.title: Dark Cinematic Portrait with Liquid Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key portrait featuring a single eye visible through a dark mask, set against a deep navy background with heavy film grain. The composition is anchored by a large, stylized liquid-chrome title at the top and a small advisory label at the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: The single visible eye acts as the focal point, creating a direct gaze with the viewer.
The liquid texture of the typography contrasts with the matte, grainy texture of the mask.
Magenta and purple highlights on the skin and text unify the color palette against the dark blue shadows.
coreInvariants: Heavy monochromatic film grain across the entire image.
High-contrast lighting that leaves most of the frame in near-black shadow.
A specific magenta-to-blue gradient in the highlights.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's eye is positioned slightly above the horizontal center, scaled to occupy the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, distorted title at the top provides the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer starts at the liquid text, drops down to the illuminated eye, and finally settles on the small advisory badge in the corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in deep navy blue surrounds the central features, emphasizing isolation.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Magenta/Pink (Highlights on skin and text edges)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low value overall with high saturation in the narrow highlight bands.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are rendered as 3D liquid volumes with high-gloss reflections.
Outer edges are blurred and distorted as if melting or underwater.
Internal highlights follow a magenta and purple gradient.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical strokes are thick and undulating.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant liquid display face paired with a standard sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the viscous, dark-fantasy aesthetic of the title.
Captures the distorted, reflective quality of the glyphs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key cinematic portrait of a person wearing a black balaclava, only one eye visible. Use deep navy blue lighting with magenta highlights on the skin. Apply heavy film grain and high contrast. The bottom half should be almost entirely black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large centered title at the top using a custom liquid-metal gothic font. The text should have a 3D viscous appearance with magenta and purple reflections. Add a small rectangular parental advisory logo in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the grain consistent across the entire image?
Does the text look like 3D liquid rather than a flat font?
Is the lighting restricted to magenta/purple highlights?
Is the eye the only clearly defined facial feature?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the liquid distortion.
Verify the magenta highlights on the text match the lighting on the eye.
Check that the navy blue shadows do not contain unwanted color noise.
Confirm the composition feels weighted toward the top and center.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key lighting + Liquid Gothic Typography + Heavy Monochromatic Grain = Dark Cinematic Mystery Aesthetic
